data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Switching 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if filled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. No guaranteed recovery or long-run optimum; intentions aren't binding. Other allocations need recalculation. Fellow recruiters, help seek individual opt-ins.
